notes: Migrated to the unified Fact model (fin/1-20 rollout continuation). New wants-cleric-presence SINK (to:'Battlefield', types:{has:['Cleric']}) mirrors aerith-gainsborough's own legendary-creature presence sink, narrowed to Cleric.
